Frequently Asked Questions

Clear, anatomically sound answers vetted by professional bra fitters.

How do French and Spanish band sizes work? ▾

French (FR) and Spanish (ES) bra sizes add 15 to the European (EU) band number. For instance, a 70 band in EU sizing is labeled as an 85 band in France and Spain.

What is an Australian bra size equivalent to? ▾

Australia uses dress sizing numbers for bra bands: Band 28 is AU 6, Band 30 is AU 8, Band 32 is AU 10, Band 34 is AU 12, Band 36 is AU 14, and Band 38 is AU 16. Australia uses the UK cup progression.
